items.jp: 暇なとき映画を見る

translation.pt-BR: Quando tenho tempo livre, assisto filme.
translation.en: When I have free time, I watch movies.

items.label: direct-object particle
items.explanation: を marks 映画 as that which is watched; it is the direct object of the verb 見る.

items.jp: 友だちはギターを弾くのが上手です

translation.pt-BR: Meu amigo toca violão muito bem.
translation.en: My friend plays the guitar really well.

items.label: direct-object particle
items.explanation: を links ギター to the verb 弾く, indicating what is played.

items.jp: 片仮名とひらがなを覚えました

translation.pt-BR: Aprendi o katakana e o hiragana.
translation.en: I learned katakana and hiragana.

items.label: direct object
items.explanation: を marks the set "katakana and hiragana" as what was memorized.
tokens: direct object (1st item of the list)
direct object (2nd item of the list)

items.jp: テーブルに箸を並べてください

translation.pt-BR: Ponha os hashis na mesa, por favor.
translation.en: Please set the chopsticks on the table.

items.label: direct-object particle
items.explanation: を marks 箸 ('chopsticks') as what directly undergoes the action of the verb 並べる ('to arrange/set out').

items.jp: 片仮名で名前を書いてください

translation.pt-BR: Escreva seu nome em katakana, por favor.
translation.en: Please write your name in katakana.

items.label: marks the direct object
items.explanation: を points to 名前 as what will be written (the object of 書く).

items.jp: 図書館で辞典を借りた

translation.pt-BR: Peguei um dicionário emprestado na biblioteca.
translation.en: I borrowed a dictionary from the library.

items.label: direct-object particle
items.explanation: を marks 辞典 (dictionary) as the direct object that receives the action of 借りる (to borrow).

items.jp: 僕はカーテン越しに海を見た

translation.pt-BR: Olhei o mar através da cortina.
translation.en: He looked at the sea through the curtains.

items.label: direct-object particle
items.explanation: Marks 海 as that which was looked at. を indicates the direct target of the verb 見る.
tokens: modifier (base of カーテン越し)
suffix that forms a phrase (越し)

items.jp: 一人一人がまず年間の売上目標を立てる

translation.pt-BR: Cada um deve primeiro definir a meta anual de vendas.
translation.en: Each person must first establish an annual sales target.

items.label: direct-object particle (accusative)
items.explanation: を marks 年間の売上目標 as the direct object of 立てる; it points to the target that will be set.

items.jp: それが少しずつ姿を変えます

translation.pt-BR: Aquilo vai mudando de forma aos poucos.
translation.en: It will change little by little.

items.label: direct-object particle (accusative)
items.explanation: を marks 姿 as the direct object of 変える ('to change shape'); it points to what is being transformed.

items.jp: 電車が、徐々にスピードを落とす

translation.pt-BR: O trem vai reduzindo a velocidade aos poucos.
translation.en: The train slows down little by little.

items.label: marks the direct object
items.explanation: を marks スピード as that which is reduced by the verb 落とす.
tokens: stem of the adverb 徐々に

items.jp: 大きな鏡で自分をしっかり見詰める

translation.pt-BR: Encare bem você mesmo num espelho grande.
translation.en: Stare at yourself in a large mirror.

items.label: direct object
items.explanation: を marks 自分 as the direct target of the verb 見詰める (it is oneself that one gazes at).

items.jp: それがさらにあなたの魅力を引き出す

translation.pt-BR: Isso realça ainda mais o seu charme.
translation.en: It will enhance your charm.

items.label: direct-object particle
items.explanation: を marks あなたの魅力 as that on which the verb 引き出す acts: the charm that is brought out.

items.jp: 美しさに、すっかり心を奪われます

translation.pt-BR: Você fica completamente encantado com a beleza.
translation.en: You will be totally captivated by the beauty.

items.label: direct-object particle
items.explanation: を marks 心 ('heart') within the fixed phrase 心を奪われる ('to have one's heart stolen' = to be enchanted). Here を is part of the idiomatic expression, not of a literal object.

items.jp: 必ず同じ病気を発症するわけではない

translation.pt-BR: Isso não quer dizer que vão necessariamente desenvolver a mesma doença.
translation.en: It doesn't mean they will develop the same disease.

items.label: direct-object particle
items.explanation: を marks 病気 (illness) as the object of the verb 発症する: it is the illness that develops/manifests.
tokens: verbal noun (base of 発症する)
formal noun (head of わけではない)

items.jp: その姿にはいつも心を打たれます

translation.pt-BR: Essa imagem sempre me emociona.
translation.en: It always moves me.

items.label: marks the direct object
items.explanation: を marks 心 as the object of 打つ. Even in the passive 打たれる, the fixed expression 心を打たれる keeps を on 心 (the affected part).

items.jp: 公衆トイレで必ず用を足しておきましょう

translation.pt-BR: Vamos usar o banheiro público antes, sem falta.
translation.en: Be sure to go to the restroom.

items.label: marks the direct object
items.explanation: を marks 用 as the object of 足す, within the fixed expression 用を足す.

items.jp: 高校生がこのロボットを製作しました。

translation.pt-BR: Um estudante do ensino médio fez este robô.
translation.en: A high school student made this robot.

items.label: marks the direct object
items.explanation: を indicates このロボット (this robot) as what was made by the action of 製作する.
tokens: verbal object (forms the verb with する)

items.jp: 風がやんだら沖まで船を出そう。

translation.pt-BR: Quando o vento parar, vamos levar o barco até o alto-mar.
translation.en: After the wind has stopped, let's sail the boat off to the open sea.

items.label: direct-object particle
items.explanation: を marks 船 ('boat') as the object of 出す ('to put/take out'), what will be put out to sea.
tokens: conditional auxiliary 〜たら (voiced variant だら)

items.jp: きのう電車に傘を忘れました。

translation.pt-BR: Ontem esqueci o guarda-chuva no trem.
translation.en: I left my umbrella on the train yesterday.

items.label: direct-object particle
items.explanation: を marks 傘 (umbrella) as the target of the action of forgetting.

items.jp: 毎年、母に誕生日のプレゼントをあげます。

translation.pt-BR: Todo ano dou um presente de aniversário para a minha mãe.
translation.en: I give my mother a birthday present every year.

items.label: marks the direct object
items.explanation: を indicates what is given, that is, the present is the direct target of the verb あげる.

items.jp: こういう人は節約を楽しんでるタイプね。

translation.pt-BR: Gente assim é do tipo que curte economizar, né.
translation.en: That kind of person is the type who enjoys saving money, you know.

items.label: marks the direct object
items.explanation: を marks 節約 ('to save/economize') as what this person enjoys (object of 楽しむ).
tokens: verb within the expression こういう ('of this kind')

items.jp: なかなか興味深いことをおっしゃいますね？

translation.pt-BR: O senhor diz coisas bem interessantes, não é?
translation.en: You say really interesting things, don't you?

items.label: direct-object particle
items.explanation: Marks 興味深いこと ('interesting things') as the object of the verb おっしゃる ('to say').
tokens: component of the adjective 興味深い

items.jp: 騒いでいたのでバスの運転手はこちらを睨んだ。

translation.pt-BR: Como estávamos fazendo barulho, o motorista do ônibus nos lançou um olhar feroz.
translation.en: The bus driver glared at us for shouting.

items.label: direct-object particle (o)
items.explanation: Marks こちら as the direct target of the action 睨む ('to glare'): it was 'in our direction' that he looked angrily.

items.jp: 川の近くにテントを張った。

translation.pt-BR: Armamos a barraca perto do rio.
translation.en: We set up the tent next to the river.

items.label: marks the direct object
items.explanation: を indicates what was pitched, that is, the tent is the direct target of the verb 張る.

items.jp: 社長は会議のために顧問たちを集めた。

translation.pt-BR: O presidente reuniu seus conselheiros para a reunião.
translation.en: The president assembled his advisers for a conference.

items.label: direct-object particle
items.explanation: Marks 顧問たち ('the advisors') as the object of the verb 集めた ('gathered').

items.jp: 自分の姿を鏡にうつして見なさい。

translation.pt-BR: Olhe a sua própria imagem refletida no espelho.
translation.en: Look at yourself in the mirror.

items.label: marks the direct object
items.explanation: を marks 自分の姿 as that which one should project and look at: it is the object of the actions うつす and 見る.
tokens: complement of place (destination of the projection)

items.jp: 私は漫画を読む習慣がなくなりました。

translation.pt-BR: Perdi o hábito de ler mangás.
translation.en: I have grown out of the habit of reading comics.

items.label: marks the direct object
items.explanation: を marks 漫画 (manga) as the object of the verb 読む within the relative clause 'to read manga.'
tokens: verb of the relative clause (modifies 習慣)

items.jp: 私の趣味はピアノを弾くことです。

translation.pt-BR: Meu hobby é tocar piano.
translation.en: My hobby is playing the piano.

items.label: marks the direct object
items.explanation: を marks ピアノ as that which one plays; it belongs to the inner clause ピアノを弾く, which is then nominalized by こと.

items.jp: 私たちは親をあてにしてはいけない。

translation.pt-BR: Nós não devemos depender dos nossos pais.
translation.en: We should not depend on your parents.

items.label: を of direct object
items.explanation: Marks 親 (the parents) as that which one 'depends on'; あてにする governs its object with を.
tokens: noun within the fixed expression あてにする
verb of the phrase あてにする (to depend on)

items.jp: 私たちはそれを公にしようと思う。

translation.pt-BR: Nós pretendemos tornar isso público.
translation.en: We will make it public.

items.label: direct-object particle (accusative)
items.explanation: を marks それ as the direct object of する (that which will be made public.)

items.jp: 子供を誉めることは大事なことだ。

translation.pt-BR: Elogiar as crianças é uma coisa importante.
translation.en: Praising children is an important thing.

items.label: marks the direct object
items.explanation: を indicates that 子供 ('children') is the object of the verb 誉める ('to praise'), within the clause that will be nominalized by こと.
tokens: nominalizer (turns the action into a noun)
auxiliary (attributive な form of だ)

items.jp: 傘をもっていかなくてはならない。

translation.pt-BR: Preciso levar um guarda-chuva comigo.
translation.en: I've got to take an umbrella with me.

items.label: direct-object particle を
items.explanation: Marks 傘 ('umbrella') as the object of the action of taking.
tokens: verb (1st part of the compound もっていく)
main verb (2nd part of the compound)
auxiliary verb of the obligation construction

items.jp: 鏡の汚れをおとしてきれいにしなさい。

translation.pt-BR: Tire a sujeira do espelho e deixe-o limpo.
translation.en: Clean the mirror.

items.label: marks the direct object
items.explanation: を marks 鏡の汚れ as the object that undergoes the action of おとす ('to remove'): it is the dirt that should be removed.
tokens: marker of result (に of きれいにする)

items.jp: デパートではいつでも大きな展覧会を見られる。

translation.pt-BR: Na loja de departamentos dá para ver uma grande exposição a qualquer hora.
translation.en: You can see the large exhibition at the department store anytime.

items.label: direct-object particle
items.explanation: を marks 'great exhibition' as what can be seen.
tokens: interrogative pronoun (base of いつでも)

items.jp: ちょっと暑いのでジャケットを脱ぎます。

translation.pt-BR: Está um pouco quente, então vou tirar a jaqueta.
translation.en: I'd like to take my jacket off, please; it's too hot.

items.label: direct-object particle
items.explanation: を marks ジャケット (jacket) as the direct object of the action 脱ぐ (to take off). It indicates what directly undergoes the action of the verb.

items.jp: ジャムを上の棚から降ろしてくれ。

translation.pt-BR: Me tira a geleia da prateleira de cima.
translation.en: Take the jam down from the top shelf.

items.label: direct-object particle
items.explanation: を marks ジャム ('jam') as the direct object of the verb 降ろす ('to bring/take down').
tokens: point of origin (where to take from)

items.jp: これを壊したのはだれですか。

translation.pt-BR: Quem foi que quebrou isto?
translation.en: Who broke this?

items.label: marks the direct object
items.explanation: を indicates what undergoes the action of 壊す (to break): これ (this) is the thing broken.

items.jp: この次に償いをするよ。

translation.pt-BR: Da próxima vez eu compenso isso.
translation.en: I will make up for it next time.

items.label: direct-object particle
items.explanation: を marks 償い ("the amends") as that which will be made (the object of する.)

items.jp: あなたはお父さんの誕生日を覚えていますか。

translation.pt-BR: Você lembra do aniversário do seu pai?
translation.en: Do you remember your father's birthday?

items.label: marks the direct object
items.explanation: を marks 誕生日 ('birthday') as the object of the verb 覚える ('to remember').

items.jp: 電車のなかに傘を忘れてきた。

translation.pt-BR: Esqueci o guarda-chuva no trem.
translation.en: I left my umbrella on the train.

items.label: direct-object particle
items.explanation: を marks 傘 (umbrella) as what undergoes the action of 忘れる (to forget).

items.jp: 試験が教育を駄目にしていると思う。

translation.pt-BR: Acho que as provas estão arruinando a educação.
translation.en: I think exams are ruining education.

items.label: direct-object particle
items.explanation: を marks 教育 as that which receives the action of 駄目にする ('to render useless').

items.jp: 厳しいトレーニングに、彼は音を上げた。

translation.pt-BR: Ele não aguentou o treinamento pesado.
translation.en: He gave up under the severe training he faced.

items.label: direct-object particle (を)
items.explanation: を links 音 to the verb 上げる. Together they form the set phrase 音を上げる ('to give up'), so here を is part of the expression and not a literally translated object.

items.jp: 僕はおばあちゃんの家を訪ねたんだ。

translation.pt-BR: Fui visitar a casa da minha vó.
translation.en: I visited my grandmother's house.

items.label: marks the direct object
items.explanation: を points to 家 ('the house') as the direct target of the verb 訪ねた ('to visit'). It is what directly receives the action.
tokens: auxiliary (copula of the んだ structure)

items.jp: 壁を塗るつもりです。

translation.pt-BR: Pretendo pintar a parede.
translation.en: We're going to paint the wall.

items.label: marks the direct object of the verb
items.explanation: を marks 壁 ('wall') as the target of the action of 塗る ('to paint'): that which will be painted.

items.jp: 壁を塗っている人は私のお父さんだ。

translation.pt-BR: O homem que está pintando a parede é o meu pai.
translation.en: The man painting the wall is my father.

items.label: marks the direct object of the verb
items.explanation: を marks 壁 ('wall') as the target of 塗る ('to paint') within the relative clause 'who is painting the wall.'
tokens: noun modified by the relative clause (topic)

items.jp: 壁は大きな音をたててガラガラと倒れた。

translation.pt-BR: O muro desabou com estrondo, fazendo um barulho enorme.
translation.en: The fence fell with a great crash.

items.label: direct-object particle (を)
items.explanation: Marks 大きな音 ('a huge noise') as the object of たてる ('to make/produce'): it is the sound that is produced.

items.jp: 風邪引かないようにコートを着た。

translation.pt-BR: Vesti um casaco para não pegar resfriado.
translation.en: I wore a coat lest I catch a cold.

items.label: marks the direct object
items.explanation: を marks コート as what was put on.
tokens: part of the phrase ように

items.jp: 風邪を引かないように注意しよう。

translation.pt-BR: Vamos tomar cuidado para não pegar resfriado.
translation.en: Let's be careful not to catch a cold.

items.label: marks the direct object
items.explanation: を marks 風邪 as what one wants to avoid catching.
tokens: part of the phrase ように

items.jp: 風邪をひかないようにしなさいよ。

translation.pt-BR: Cuide para não pegar resfriado, viu?
translation.en: Take care not to catch a cold.

items.label: marks the direct object
items.explanation: を marks 風邪 as what one wants to avoid catching.
tokens: part of the phrase ように

items.jp: 父はその人を書斎に入れた。

translation.pt-BR: Meu pai levou aquela pessoa para dentro do escritório.
translation.en: Father showed him into the study.

items.label: direct-object particle
items.explanation: を marks その人 ('that person') as the thing undergoing the action of 入れる.

items.jp: 秘密をしゃべってしまったのはだれだ。

translation.pt-BR: Quem foi que acabou contando o segredo?
translation.en: Who is guilty of telling the secret?

items.label: marks the direct object
items.explanation: を indicates what was told: 秘密 (the secret) is the object of しゃべる (to talk).

items.jp: 彼女はいつも絹の服を着ている。

translation.pt-BR: Ela está sempre vestida de seda.
translation.en: She is always clothed in silk.

items.label: direct-object particle
items.explanation: を marks 絹の服 as the target of the verb 着る (to wear): it is the clothing that she wears.

items.jp: その子は漫画をいっぱい持ってるんだ。

translation.pt-BR: Essa criança tem um monte de mangás.
translation.en: The kid has a lot of mangas.

items.label: marks the direct object
items.explanation: を marks 漫画 (manga) as the object of the verb 持ってる (to have/possess).

items.jp: ふりがなのある読みやすい漫画を探してる。

translation.pt-BR: Estou procurando um mangá fácil de ler que tenha furigana.
translation.en: I'm looking for an easy-to-read manga with furigana.

items.label: marks the direct object
items.explanation: を marks 漫画 ('manga') as the target of the action of 探す ('to look for').
tokens: verb of the clause that modifies 漫画
verbal base that forms the compound with やすい
